using Base64
using JSON3
const FILES = Dict{String,String}(
  "src/STADE.jl" => "",
  "validate_corpus_gpu.jl" => "",
  "corpus/fixed_sweeps.jl" => "",
  "corpus/geomrecur.jl" => "ZnVuY3Rpb24gZ2VvbXJlY3VyKGxvc3MsIHUsIGMsIGlfbikKICAgIGZvciBpX3ggPSAyOmlfbgogICAgICAgIHVbaV94XSA9IGMgKiB1W2lfeCAtIDFdCiAgICBlbmQKICAgIGZvciBpX3ggPSAxOmlfbgogICAgICAgIGxvc3NbMV0gPSBsb3NzWzFdICsgdVtpX3hdIF4gMgogICAgZW5kCmVuZAo=",
  "corpus/ii_readbefore.jl" => "",
  "corpus/ii_readnested.jl" => "",
  "corpus/matvec_loss.jl" => "",
  "corpus/mg_vcycle.jl" => "",
  "corpus/mg_vcycle_multi.jl" => "",
  "corpus/mpnn.jl" => "",
)
root = "/tmp/stade_b"
rm(root; force = true, recursive = true)
for (name, b) in FILES
    p = joinpath(root, name); mkpath(dirname(p))
    open(p, "w") do f; write(f, String(base64decode(b))); end
end
vp = joinpath(root, "validate_corpus_gpu.jl")
src = read(vp, String)
src = replace(src, "include(joinpath(@__DIR__, \"..\", \"src\", \"STADE.jl\"))" =>
                   "include(joinpath(\"" * root * "\", \"src\", \"STADE.jl\"))")
src = replace(src, "\nimport Atomix\n" => "\ntry\n    @eval import Atomix\ncatch\nend\n")
src = replace(src, "first(split(sprint(showerror, e), \"\\n\"))" => "sprint(showerror, e)")
src = replace(src, "\nvalidate_corpus_gpu()" => "\n")
open(vp, "w") do f; write(f, src); end
include(vp)
logpath = joinpath(root, "run.log"); t0 = time()
res = open(logpath, "w") do io
    redirect_stdout(io) do
        validate_corpus_gpu(joinpath(root, "corpus"); trials = 1, fuse_ii_loops = true,
                            run_cuda = true, run_jacc = false, write_generated = false)
    end
end
log = read(logpath, String)
println(JSON3.write(Dict(
    "elapsed_s" => round(time() - t0, digits = 1),
    "ok" => [r.kernel for r in res if r.status == :ok],
    "worst_ok" => maximum([r.max_rel_err for r in res if r.status == :ok]; init = 0.0),
    "bad" => [Dict("k" => r.kernel, "s" => String(r.status),
                   "e" => (isnan(r.max_rel_err) ? nothing : r.max_rel_err)) for r in res if r.status != :ok],
    "msgs" => first(join([l for l in split(log, "\n") if occursin("!!", l)], " ||| "), 1200))))
